verdict.rationale: Skills for Real Engineers is a bundle of SKILL.md prompt files installed into host agents such as Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and Copilot. It is not a runtime that consumes tools, so being an MCP client is a role of the host agent, which earns no credit here. Nothing in the evidence shows the bundle itself connecting to or configuring MCP servers, so the axis does not apply to this kind of product.
